items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I worked Michael's club with them too.

ctx.x: Yeah. I worked Michael's club with them too. So I covered most of the fiddle players. And Stuff Smith was extra special because I was with him when my first born was born, you know, in Chicago.
Stuff Smith is probably the -- the most swinging of all the fiddle players, wouldn't you say?
